The three base Damage records consume self Intimidated, its negation plus Party:Intimidated, and Debilitated. Selected complete raw inputs contain no supplying Condition flags, explicit overrides or direct state entries. EnemyModifier delivery targets the enemy, not the friendly recipient. Party data is separately accounted and empty.

Complete body scan covers literal and dynamic assignments. Dynamic names are weapon/slot, flask/charm, AffectedBy, SelfCast, NeverCrit and local attack flags; none can synthesize Intimidated or Debilitated under the pinned selected input closure.

The selected explicit RaisedSkeletonSniper profile uses the friendly intrinsic table, not monsterDamage; hiddenDamageFixup is zero by the selected factory branch. This is not inferred from zero numerical output alone.

Complete selected pass census enumerates both skill/global conversion names for every damage pair and both gain-name families. No selected raw conversion or gain-as-Physical source exists. SkillPhysicalDamageConvertToFire on Arsonist recipes is a different exact skill recipient and is not admitted to this Action.

DamageGainAsRandom is a base Faerie Fire source whose name is not included in the historical raw pass whitelist. Its factory produces Fire/Cold/Lightning gain only; none changes a Physical endpoint under the admitted identity conversion domain. PhysicalDamageConvertToRandom is also omitted by that whitelist and is rejected recursively from the complete selected constructor and recipe inputs, including zero/inactive records. Random elemental gain remains required for later elemental and full damage outputs.

Physical calculation combines Damage and PhysicalDamage; selected raw census includes potential inactive and zero records and contains no PhysicalDamage or Min/MaxPhysicalDamage suppliers. Generic conditional factories are bounded by the complete selected source inputs and captured final raw records; native package publication also authenticates all selected occurrence definitions and all potential writers.

Self/party intimidation is one OR penalty. Debilitation is the first Damage MORE source, before quality and Gigantic; fold the unrounded source factors then round the MORE bucket once before the final damage rounding. Native uses semantic booleans and explicit numeric rounding, not Lua truthiness.
